feature: SOP agent loop with tool use
description: Convert the SOP 'accept' content-generation path from one-shot persona inference to a ReAct agent loop with callable tools (repo_read, repo_grep, cargo_check, code_patch_propose). Closes the content-quality gap surfaced by today's end-to-end dogfooding run (2026-05-27): the outer SOP shell now works (classifier → typed commitments → drafter → twin → executor) but local-AI drafts have fabricated imports, markdown fences, and other one-shot blind-prediction artifacts. Letting the persona read the target file + check compilation + iterate before submitting eliminates this class of failure.
acceptance_gate: Re-dispatching today's P7.2 brief (`hex ci --standalone-gate` wiring) through the new loop produces a hex-cli/tests/standalone_gate.rs file that: (a) the persona called repo_read at least once before code_patch_propose, (b) cargo_check returned success on the final draft, (c) twin accepted first pass, (d) cargo test -p hex-cli --test standalone_gate -- --nocapture exits 0 with HEX_NEXUS_URL+OLLAMA_HOST set, (e) zero frontier-model calls in the trajectory.

tasks.name: IAgentTool trait + Observation/ToolError types
tasks.description: Define `pub trait IAgentTool { fn name(&self) -> &str; fn schema(&self) -> serde_json::Value; async fn invoke(&self, args: serde_json::Value) -> Result<Observation, ToolError>; }`. Observation carries `output: String + truncated: bool + bytes: usize`. ToolError is a thiserror enum {InvalidArgs, NotFound, PolicyDenied, Exec, Timeout}. mod.rs re-exports the trait + a `Trajectory` skeleton.
tasks.done_condition: cargo check -p hex-nexus passes. trait is pub. mod.rs is in orchestration/mod.rs.

tasks.description: Implements IAgentTool. args: {pattern, path_glob?}. Wraps `rg --json` (ripgrep) — if rg not on PATH, falls back to `grep -RnI`. Returns at most 50 matches as `path:line: text` lines. 5s timeout.

Returns success/failure + first 30 lines of diagnostics. Uses tokio::process. Workspace-root resolution via HEX_REPO_ROOT or current_dir.

tasks.name: Driver loop with persona inference + tool dispatch
tasks.description: pub async fn run(role, task_brief, tools: Vec<Box<dyn IAgentTool>>, max_steps, inference: Arc<dyn IInferencePort>, model) -> Result<Trajectory>. Each step: build prompt from (system + task_brief + accumulated observations + tool descriptions), call inference, parse {thought, action: {tool, args}} JSON, dispatch tool by name, record step, append observation. Loop until terminal tool or max_steps. Max token budget = 32k cumulative.
tasks.done_condition: Test with MockInferencePort returning fixed sequence: produces a 3-step trajectory ending in code_patch_propose. Parser tolerates leading ```json fence + trailing prose.

tasks.name: Driver tests — termination conditions
tasks.description: Cover: (a) clean termination on code_patch_propose, (b) max_steps exhausted → TerminatedReason::MaxSteps, (c) token budget exhausted → TerminatedReason::TokenBudget, (d) malformed JSON 3x → TerminatedReason::ParseExhausted, (e) tool returns ToolError::PolicyDenied → step recorded, loop continues, (f) tool times out → step recorded with error, loop continues.
tasks.done_condition: cargo test -p hex-nexus driver_tests passes with 6 assertions green.

tasks.name: Pre-twin compile gate
tasks.description: Before promoting a pending proposed_action to twin review, write its content to a temp tree (target/agent-loop-scratch/<id>/<path>), run cargo check on the affected crate, capture pass/fail + first 30 lines of diagnostics. On fail: mark the proposed_action with compile_status='fail' + diagnostics, do NOT send to twin, instead post a synthetic observation back into the trajectory (re-fires the agent loop with the error in context). On pass: send to twin as today.
tasks.done_condition: Integration test: a draft that fails to compile gets compile_status=fail + diagnostics + a new agent_step with the error appended; twin is not invoked.

tasks.name: Feed twin rejection back into the trajectory
tasks.description: When twin emits a rejection on a proposed_action that was produced by the agent loop, drafter looks up the trajectory_id, appends a synthetic AgentStep with the rejection rationale as the observation, and re-fires agent_loop::run(resume=true) with the appended context. Existing REJECT_BUDGET still bounds total attempts (3) but each attempt now has more context.
tasks.done_condition: Integration test: twin rejects draft → next trajectory step shows the rejection rationale in its system context.
